section5.text: A proper first visit, not a five-minute look. You leave knowing what is going on, what needs doing, what can wait, and what it would cost.

story.caption: This is a real Arvada Dental patient. He came to us with several missing teeth, failing restorations, and a long history of patchwork dentistry. Drag the slider to see what became possible when his care was rebuilt around one complete plan.

story-before.text: Three offices, three sets of paperwork
A different dentist for every family member
Kids' appointments always during school hours
A child who dreaded going, and said so
Nobody holding the full picture of anyone

story-after.text: One practice for all four of them
Appointments back to back, one trip
The same dentist who knows every history
A child who now asks to pick the toothpaste
Everyone due together, easy to remember

story.before-alt: Smile before dental implant treatment at Arvada Dental Center
story.after-alt: Patient's healthy smile after treatment at Arvada Dental Center

story-chapters.quote: “I was driving to three different offices.”
story-chapters.text: The kids go one place, you go another, and your parents somewhere else again. Three sets of forms, three sets of hours, and three receptionists who do not know your family.
story-chapters.alt: Dr. Kim listening to a patient at the first consultation

story-chapters.quote: “They booked all four of us the same morning.”
story-chapters.text: One call moves everyone across. We schedule family visits back to back where the day allows, so a single morning covers the whole household instead of three separate trips.
story-chapters.alt: Digital X-rays and treatment planning at Arvada Dental Center

story-chapters.text: Children get shown the tools, told what happens next, and never rushed. For a genuinely anxious child or adult we slow right down and sedation is available where it is appropriate.
story-chapters.alt: Calm, modern treatment room at Arvada Dental Center

story-chapters.quote: “He has watched my kids grow up.”
story-chapters.text: Dr. Bennett has been at this address since 2003. Families who started with him bring their own children now the same dentist, holding the whole history.
story-chapters.alt: Patient's healthy smile after treatment at Arvada Dental Center

faq.q: Which insurance plans do you accept?
faq.a: We accept a wide range of insurance plans. During your first visit, all your clinical and financial questions will be answered.

faq.q: I don’t have Insurance, what do I do?
faq.a: No insurance? No problem. We have offers and payment plan options that will make your treatment very affordable.

faq.q: What is the new patient experience like?
faq.a: New patients will first do a comprehensive full-mouth examination. Then, the doctor will provide the treatment options.

We offer consultations that may be covered by insurance or provided at a reduced cost, depending on your coverage. We believe in the quality of our practice and are committed to providing exceptional service during these consultations.

faq.q: Do you have payment plan options?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely! We have payment solutions for all budgets. We make high quality dental care affordable.

faq.q: How many visits do I need to make?
faq.a: The number of visits depend on your case.

faq.q: How long will my treatment take?
faq.a: We do the full spectrum of dentistry. All treatments are done in-house.
